PewDiePie burns himself out, why you should take a break from videogames.

I don't usually watch this guy, but I've been hearing some weird shit is going on with him and I came across this video. Halfway through the video pewdiepie has a half-thought about Overwatch that actually is a pretty accurate descriptor of why I personally don't play as many games as I used to.

Like Felix I used to play a shit ton more video games than I do currently, and I still love video games. When he talks about Overwatch I realized I felt the exact same way. I like playing Overwatch, it's fun, but it feels like a chore to play it because I already know what to expect. I end up only playing when there's new content like skins or a new hero, but it's always short lived.

I'm pretty close to his age right now and I feel like I'm not doing what I really want to do. Like do I play games because I want to be a skilled gamer? Is the way I see myself congruent with someone who is just really good at playing Tracer? The answer is no. I see gaming as more of a reflection of who I am rather than part of who I am.

I think video games are fun, and I enjoy them a lot. But as it turns out I'm realizing that gaming is more of a convenient outlet, a low risk reward that allows me to feel accomplished even though I'm not really doing anything. I'm middle of the pack in terms of skill because I get bored of a game before I ever get really good at it, so there's no point in thinking I could "go pro", not that I would want to.

So here I leave you with something I made last night. I have played hundreds of games and put thousands of hours into many of them, and I've had my fun- but I feel much more satisfied when I've created something purely from my own imagination. The more times I play games the more I realize I'd rather be making my own stories, making my own characters, creating my own adventures.

If you don't find games as fun as you used to, consider taking a break to think about why you play games, even if your conclusions don't change a break from gaming will make it more rewarding the next time you sit down to play.
